scope: coding-agent product fork only; lower agent/provider layers unchanged

npm_distribution.relation: The worker installs the npm registry tarball of the same 0.85.1 release built from the pinned commit. Its package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json are byte-identical to upstream/package.json and upstream/npm-shrinkwrap.json (hashes in files), so its nested dependency tree follows the upstream shrinkwrap. Unpatched; only root exports are imported.
npm_distribution.install: npm --prefix packages/pi-worker ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund (the skipped install scripts of esbuild, protobufjs and @google/genai are not needed by the worker)

@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent.use: SDK root exports: createAgentSession, ModelRuntime, SessionManager, SettingsManager, DefaultResourceLoader

@earendil-works/pi-ai.use: createAssistantMessageEventStream and stream types for the lade-fixture provider; a second copy beside the shrinkwrapped nested one

undici.use: global dispatcher tunnelling through the LADE gateway socket; the version pi pins
